title: Choose a layout structure
question: Which page structure should guide the customer, restaurant-owner, and admin surfaces? Choose a layout or ask for another hand.

options.label: Role home + next action
options.thesis: Each role lands on its next useful task, with marketplace activity kept close.
options.viewport: A familiar top navigation leads into a role-specific next action and compact marketplace or operations summary.
options.risk: An overview can add a step for customers whose only task is browsing.

options.label: Work queue + selected record
options.thesis: A focused queue and adjacent details keep review and pickup tasks in one place.
options.viewport: Role navigation stays familiar while a filterable reservation list sits beside the selected order and pickup action.
options.risk: A dense two-pane pattern can feel cramped outside owner and admin workflows.

options.label: Guided steps + active task
options.thesis: A short progress rail makes multi-step setup and checkout feel manageable.
options.viewport: A visible step sequence frames one focused task, with clear progress and the required square restaurant-logo upload.
options.risk: Persistent step framing may over-structure simple browsing and moderation tasks.
